QuestInfo.name: Boulder Muncher Test?!
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Brighton, the Battle Mage instructor at the Secret Plaza.
QuestInfo.1: Brighton wants to know if Battle Mages that have taken their 2nd job advancements have enough SP. He's offered SP to anyone that can pass his simple test.\nProve that you have what it takes to defeat the Big Boulder Muncher and Baby Boulder Muncher. Sounds like light exercise for you, doesn't it? Into the Mine!\n
QuestInfo.2:
Brighton wants to know if Battle Mages who have taken their 2nd job advancements have enough SP. He's offered SP to anyone who can pass his simple test.
Prove that you have what it takes to defeat the Big Boulder Muncher and Baby Boulder Muncher.
You effortlessly destroyed the monsters and received #e#b6 SP for 2nd job skills#k#n.

0.0: Congratulations on the 2nd Job Advancement! Being a Battle Mage isn't an easy job. I bet you're even going to find that you don't have enough SP to learn all the skills that are available. I tell you what, since I like you, I'll let you do a little test for some more SP.

yes.0: Alright! Go down to the Mine Entrance and do a little fighting. I want you to break down 50 Baby Boulder Munchers and 20 Big Boulder Munchers. You manage to crack those toughies, and I'll give you 6 SP for your 2nd Job. Show me what a real Battle Mage can do!

no.0: Settling for what you've got, huh? That's not the Resistance way! If we settle, we'll never make our freedom happen!

1.0: I knew you had a bright future! As promised, here's a little SP to beef up your skills!

yes.0: See how far you can go!
